title: Broken Before Opening Night
about: An injury shortly before State Arts-In changed the role I expected to have and unexpectedly opened a different path.
description: This track tells the story of getting injured about two weeks before opening night and realizing I could no longer perform as planned. After calling Kirsten with the news, I arrived on crutches facing a completely different State Arts-In experience than the one I'd expected. What initially felt like losing my place in the show eventually led me toward another side of the production and a path I would come to value even more.
lyrics: Verse 1
Two weeks left till the curtains rose,
Everything was set to go.
I had my place beneath the lights,
Dreaming of those summer nights.
Trying hard to show off proud,
One bad step changed all around.
In a heartbeat all my plans
Slipped away right through my hands.
Pre-Chorus
One phone call, one change of plans,
Nothing turned out how I'd planned.
Chorus
I was broken before opening night,
Thought I'd lost my chance to shine.
Watched the stage from a different side,
Wondering if I'd still belong inside.
Funny how the story goes,
Life can change with one wrong move.
I thought one door had closed for good,
It led me somewhere better than I knew.
Verse 2
Called up Kirsten, broke the news,
"I can't perform... I've got to choose."
Packed my hopes inside a box,
Rolled on in with crutches' rocks.
Everyone could see the pain,
Wondering if I'd be the same.
Still the music filled the room,
Even though I'd changed my tune.
Pre-Chorus
Every dream had changed somehow,
Still the show was calling now.
Chorus
I was broken before opening night,
Thought I'd lost my chance to shine.
Watched the stage from a different side,
Wondering if I'd still belong inside.
Funny how the story goes,
Life can change with one wrong move.
I thought one door had closed for good,
It led me somewhere better than I knew.
Bridge
If that fall had never come,
I'd have sung beneath the sun.
Never knowing all the roads
Hidden where the shadows grow.
Sometimes what feels like the end
Is where another story begins.
Final Chorus
I was broken before opening night,
Yet I found another light.
Not the path I'd planned to take,
Still the one I wouldn't trade.
Looking back, I finally see,
What felt like loss was changing me.
Broken before opening night...
Still found my place beneath the lights.
